test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Chinese Buddhist pilgrim Fa Hien visited India during the reign of which of the following Gupta emperors?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Cnhadragupta II.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fa Hien, also known as Faxian**, was a Chinese Buddhist monk and pilgrim who traveled to India in the early 5th century.
 
• He travelled through **Gobi desert **to India.
 
• "A Record of Buddhist kingdoms" (Foguo Ji), provides description of Buddhist practices, Society and Culture, Administration and Governance
 
• 
 
His visited Gupta Empire, under the reign of Emperor Chandragupta II (380–415 CE), also known as Vikramaditya.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Gupta Empire is referred to as **the "Golden Age" **of India.
 
• Their era produced great literature such as **Kalidasa, Aryabhatiya, Sushruta Samhita**.
 
• Gupta art and architecture at** Sanchi and Ajanta Caves, **which are adorned with intricate carvings and frescoes.
 
• The **varna (caste) system **was prevalent, but there was also significant patronage of education, arts, and religion.
